page.layout: One printed block only: an engraved bookplate in the centre of the page (coat of arms within an oval, with a ring of lettering and a label below). No running text. Handwriting at the top and a few stains and metal fittings at the edges are not printed text.

main_text.l: SALVATORIS POLLINGAE · A. 1744 · FRANCISCUS PRAEPOSITUS S. S.

page.notes: Engraved ex libris bookplate of Franciscus, Provost of St. Salvator at Polling, dated 1744, with a coat of arms in an oval. The ring lettering reads around the oval, with "FRANCISCUS PRAEPOSITUS" on the upper right and "S. SALVATORIS POLLINGAE" on the left; the label below reads "AD BIBLIOTHECAM IBIDEM". The ring lettering is read from the scan and partly abbreviated as printed. Handwritten shelf mark at the top ("4° J. Can. P. 381") is not transcribed as printed text.
